title: verify_claim input
description: Checks a structured claim against the snapshot layer by layer (scope, resolution, semantics, evidence integrity, replay, independent corroboration, execution) and returns each layer's outcome and a scoped verdict: supported, refuted, inconclusive, or invalid. Only the proposition is checked, never the prose statement.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered.

snapshot_id.description: Null pins the current published snapshot.

oneOf.description: A symbol by name and file, in place of its id.

name.description: The name a lean row shows (BudgetLedger.consume), or the plain name (consume); it must name one symbol in the file.

path.description: The repository-relative path of the file that declares the symbol.

source.description: A symbol ID of the snapshot, or kind:qualified name, which resolves in any snapshot. Or { name, path }: the symbol of that name in that file, kept as its kind:qualified name.

freshness.description: snapshot (default) answers from the published snapshot. strict first checks that the working tree is exactly what the snapshot was built from; if not, it starts an index and refuses with STALE_INPUT naming the changed files.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.
